title: Task board
description: Open task requests any services company can quote on

help.title: Task board
help.overview: Every open task request clients posted on the portal, whether or not it matched one of your listings. Any company that sells services here can send a quote.

sections.title: What you see
items: The task's category, city (or online), budget, photos and when it closes.
How many quotes it has and their average price; never another company's quote.
The street, postcode and the client's contact are shown only when your quote is accepted.

sections.title: Send a quote
items: Your price in the task's currency, the days you need and a short proposal.
Your company keeps one quote per task while the client decides.
The quote opens a lead under Leads, where you follow it to the award.

emptyMessage: No open task request matches. New tasks appear here as clients post them.
